content.title: About
content.content: Fruit dressing is a ready‑to‑use sauce made from pureed fresh fruits, sugar and sometimes lemon juice. It has a bright fruity flavor, works well as a topping for desserts, pancakes, ice cream and as an addition to yogurt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: There are many variants of fruit dressing: berry, citrus, tropical.
Traditionally fruit dressing was prepared at home, but today it is widely available in packaged form.
Vitamin C content depends on the fruits used and can be high.
The sauce is often used in layered desserts and cakes.
Some versions contain natural thickeners such as pectin.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: Fruit dressing can provide vitamins A, C and B‑complex depending on its composition.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Fruits contain antioxidants that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber in the sauce promotes normal bowel function.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Added sugar supplies quick energy, which is convenient for children and athletes.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The high water content helps maintain fluid balance.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: High amounts of added sugar may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of cavities.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: People allergic to specific fruits (e.g., strawberries) may react to the sauce.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some commercial versions contain preservatives that can be undesirable for sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic pH may irritate the mucosa in persons with gastritis or reflux.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve fruit dressing over pancakes, waffles, ice cream, cottage cheese, yogurt, or use it as a filling for rolls and cupcakes. It can also be stirred into smoothies for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dressing refrigerated after opening, in a tightly sealed container, and use within 7‑10 days. Prevent exposure to air to avoid oxidation and flavor loss.
